verification: mocked: CI fixture HTTP through the FastAPI test client against fixture SQLite graphs with a fixture semantic source, fixture signing keys and a fake clock; receipts, context, scope and graph are the production modules.
assertions: The context response carries a receipt whose claims bind brain, project scope, execution id, task id and revision, lane, purpose, operation id, scope and ranking policy, knowledge revision, every packed reference, omitted and excluded material, a payload digest, issue time, expiry ten minutes later and key version v2.

One second before expiry the receipt verifies with the delivered payload; every reference resolves available with its current revision read from the graph store; the explanation names no omitted, stale or unavailable item.
A verification with the payload reports payload_verified true; a claims only verification reports payload_verified false and must not satisfy a gate.
The response proves retrieval and delivery, not comprehension, and carries authority recalled_evidence; the graph store snapshot is unchanged by verification.
Two adapters acknowledge delivery separately; a repeated acknowledgement from the same adapter is a replay with the same ack id.
A supporting item revised after issue is reported stale with its new revision, without its new title, and the receipt stays valid.
context_receipt_validation_failures stays empty; the second fixture repeats every assertion independently.
